visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Add the Two Entries Above
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every entry is computed with three factorial calls. Build the triangle in a 2D array where each entry is the sum of the two above it. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Each entry is the sum of the two entries above it, which is the definition of Pascal's triangle. It uses only additions, while the factorial version overflows an int once n passes 12.
